d:
The Knicks defeated the Pistons, 111-97 tonight in New York. Karl-Anthony Towns contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 20 rebounds and 3 assists, with Jalen Brunson of the Knicks adding an additional 23 points (5-18 FG) and 7 assists in the game. Paul Reed finished with a team-high 22 points along with 9 rebounds for the Pistons in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 1-3 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 3-1 for the season.
